name: Brazilian Atlantic Islands: Fernando de Noronha and Atol das Rocas Reserves
description: Far out in the South Atlantic, off Brazil's northeast coast, the volcanic peaks of Fernando de Noronha and the ring-shaped Rocas Atoll rise from an underwater ridge. Rocas is the ocean's only atoll, and at low tide its lagoons and tidal pools fill with fish. The waters shelter turtles, sharks, tuna and resident dolphins, while the islands host the Western Atlantic's biggest tropical seabird colonies.
